role: Chunk mesh probe: rebuilds every loaded section within a radius exactly as WorldRenderer.updateRenderer does (ChunkCache, RenderBlocks, both passes) but reads the Tessellator's raw vertex ints instead of drawing, so a native renderer is checked vertex by vertex; also writes the atlas and render_items.jsonl.
notes: Runs on the client thread between frames while Lockstep has the server parked. Output DIR/manifest.json, sections.bin, atlas.json. atlas.json carries "anim", RenderStateProbe.animState at the moment the block atlas is read back, so test_rendertick can rebuild the dump.
